- Dashboard with totals and charts

+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a hospital OPD manager: doctors have name, department General Medicine/Cardiology/Dermatology/Pediatrics/Orthopedics/ENT, phone, email, consultation fee in rupees, room and availability Available/On leave. Each doctor has many appointments: patient name, patient phone, date, time, reason and status Booked/Completed/Cancelled; actions: complete and cancel. Each doctor has many prescriptions: patient name, medicine, dosage, days 1-90 and instructions. Each doctor has many lab tests: patient name, test name Blood test/X-ray/MRI/ECG/Urine test, cost in rupees and status Ordered/Collected/Reported; actions: collect and report. Show total doctors, appointments per doctor, lab revenue, filter doctors by department, filter appointments by status, search doctors by name, edit and delete everything.
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+4 SQLite tables (doctors and appointments and prescriptions and lab_tests) with one database module each; every module's schema creates all tables. FastAPI routers, one per resource. Counters are owned by the server and change only through action endpoints; lists are ordered by the query field sort. A multi-page app (dashboard, a page per resource, a detail page) is served from static/.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Hospital OPD manager
+
+Manage doctors with their appointments, prescriptions and lab tests.
+
+**doctors**: name (string), department (General Medicine / Cardiology / Dermatology / Pediatrics / Orthopedics / ENT), phone (string), email (string), consultation_fee (number), room (string), availability (Available / On leave). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+**appointments**: patient_name (string), patient_phone (string), date (string), time (string), reason (string), status (Booked / Completed / Cancelled). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to doctors. Actions: complete (status = Completed), cancel (status = Cancelled).
+**prescriptions**: patient_name (string), medicine (string), dosage (string), days (integer), instructions (string). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to doctors.
+**lab_tests**: patient_name (string), test_name (Blood test / X-ray / MRI / ECG / Urine test), cost (number), status (Ordered / Collected / Reported). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to doctors. Actions: collect (status = Collected), report (status = Reported).
+
+Features:
+- Add, edit and delete doctors
+- Add, edit and delete appointments
+- Add, edit and delete prescriptions
+- Add, edit and delete lab tests
+- Filter lists by status or category
+- Search by name
+- Dashboard with totals and charts
+
+## Endpoints
+- `GET /api/doctors`: List all doctors
+- `POST /api/doctors`: Add a doctor Answers 409 when: Email already exists (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `PUT /api/doctors/{id}`: Edit one doctor Answers 409 when: Email already exists (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `DELETE /api/doctors/{id}`: Delete one doctor and its appointments, prescriptions, lab_tests
+- `GET /api/doctors/{doctor_id}/appointments`: List the appointments of one doctor
+- `POST /api/doctors/{doctor_id}/appointments`: Add a appointment to a doctor
+- `PUT /api/appointments/{id}`: Edit one appointment Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `DELETE /api/appointments/{id}`: Delete one appointment
+- `POST /api/appointments/{id}/complete`: Complete one appointment: sets status to Completed and return the updated appointment Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `POST /api/appointments/{id}/cancel`: Cancel one appointment: sets status to Cancelled and return the updated appointment Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `GET /api/doctors/{doctor_id}/prescriptions`: List the prescriptions of one doctor
+- `POST /api/doctors/{doctor_id}/prescriptions`: Add a prescription to a doctor
+- `PUT /api/prescriptions/{id}`: Edit one prescription
+- `DELETE /api/prescriptions/{id}`: Delete one prescription
+- `GET /api/doctors/{doctor_id}/lab_tests`: List the lab_tests of one doctor
+- `POST /api/doctors/{doctor_id}/lab_tests`: Add a lab_test to a doctor
+- `PUT /api/lab_tests/{id}`: Edit one lab_test Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `DELETE /api/lab_tests/{id}`: Delete one lab_test
+- `POST /api/lab_tests/{id}/collect`: Collect one lab_test: sets status to Collected and return the updated lab_test Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `POST /api/lab_tests/{id}/report`: Report one lab_test: sets status to Reported and return the updated lab_test Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+
+## Web page must
+- Form to add a doctor with name, department, phone, email, consultation fee, room, availability
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every doctor
+- Form to add a appointment with patient name, patient phone, date, time, reason, status (inside the open parent)
+- Click a doctor (Comments button) to open its appointments with a form to add one
+- A Complete button on every appointment that sets its status to Completed
+- A Cancel button on every appointment that sets its status to Cancelled
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every appointment
+- Form to add a prescription with patient name, medicine, dosage, days, instructions (inside the open parent)
